## Upgrade notes

This release upgrades the database to schema version 9 the first time `up serve` or `up tui` opens it. Older versions of up refuse the upgraded database, so back up `up.db`, `up.db.key` and `up.db.token` together before upgrading.

## Features

- **Heartbeat monitors:** watch cron jobs, backups and other scheduled work. The job sends a `POST` to its own ping URL when it finishes, or to `/fail` when it fails, and up alerts when no ping arrives within the period plus grace. Pings use the existing `--api-listen` port and a per-monitor token that grants no other access; regenerate it with Token: new.
- **Delivery log:** every down, recovery and certificate alert is recorded per channel as sent, failed or held, with the reason. Secrets never appear in the reason.
- **Notifications view:** `s` and `c` open one full-screen view with Mail servers, Channels and Deliveries tabs. Channels shows the last delivery of each channel, Deliveries is searchable with `/`, and `enter` on a channel shows only its deliveries.
- **Incidents in the monitor detail:** each outage shows its start, duration, reason and whether an alert went out, with the total downtime of the last 30 days and the most recent alerts.
- **Search and filter:** `/` searches monitors by name, URL or host from the footer, and `tab` filters by status: all, down, failing or held.
- **Duplicate monitors:** `y` opens the new monitor form filled from the selected monitor. Headers and body stay encrypted, and history, mutes and maintenance windows are not copied.
- **Deliveries API:** `GET /api/v1/deliveries` returns the delivery log, filtered by monitor or channel.
